goal: Decouple transaction data representations from call sites across the codebase
Allow future memory optimizations like shared block data without modifying callers
reviewability: Needs rebase due to conflicts with master, but the rebase is mechanical and logic can be reviewed now
agreement: Contested over massive churn across critical code without clear immediate benefit (ajtowns, l0rinc)
Renaming protocol terms like vin and vout creates confusion with external APIs (mzumsande)
Support for separating transaction layout from API to enable regular value handles (josibake, willcl-ark)
Verified automated fixups reproduce cleanly with passing tests (alexanderwiederin)

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because it is an internal architectural restructuring without immediate performance gains or bug fixes
Potential benefits like shared immutable transaction state remain exploratory future work
